help.theme: Switch between light and dark appearance.
help.language: Choose the language used by the WebUI.
help.provider: Select the provider that should serve new model requests.
help.model: Set the default model name used by OriginAgent.
help.backgroundReview: Generate pending learning proposals after successful turns. Off by default to avoid unexpected LLM cost.
help.voiceInput: Allow OriginAgent to capture microphone audio through the local-awareness audio chain.
help.voiceOutput: Allow OriginAgent to speak through the local-awareness audio output chain.
help.voiceRequireConfirmation: Require an explicit confirmation before local audio recording or playback starts.
help.voiceTranscription: Turn captured audio into text before passing it deeper into the agent flow.
help.voiceTranscriptionProvider: Choose which speech-to-text backend handles local audio transcription.
help.voiceTranscriptionLanguage: Optional 2-3 letter language hint for transcription, for example zh or en.
help.voiceMaxRecordSeconds: Maximum duration allowed for a single local audio capture request.
help.voiceDeviceId: Optional input/output device identifier used by the local-awareness chain.
help.voiceTts: Enable synthesized speech output. The current runtime routes TTS through {{provider}}.
help.voiceVoice: Optional backend speaker/voice id for synthesized speech output.
help.voiceSaveDir: Workspace-relative directory used to store captured or generated local audio artifacts.
help.showReasoning: Surface model reasoning in channels that support it.
help.sendToolHints: Stream lightweight tool-call hints during execution.
help.sendProgress: Emit progress updates during agent work.
help.allowAgentInitiatedMessages: Allow proactive nudges and reminders from idle-session active intents.
help.unifiedSession: Share one session across channels and devices.
help.coldArchive: Keep trimmed session messages in the local cold archive.
help.webTools: Enable web search and fetch tools in the runtime.
help.contentRead: Enable structured site readers such as RSS, GitHub, and Hacker News readers.
help.imageGeneration: Enable the image generation tool in chat turns.
help.execEnabled: Register the exec tool for shell command execution.
help.execProfile: Choose the safety profile used by exec.
help.auditMode: Choose how much tool audit data the runtime retains.
help.runtimeProfile: Select the runtime safety profile applied at startup.
help.metaCognition: Enable the agent's self-reflection pipeline. When disabled, no triggers are collected and no reflections are generated.
help.triggerCollection: Collect tool failures, user corrections, and task completions as reflection triggers.
help.structuredReflection: Use an LLM to analyze triggers and generate structured reflections with root cause hypotheses and learned rules.
help.patternConsolidation: Group similar reflections into error patterns for trend analysis and evolution targeting.
help.evolutionBridge: Bridge error patterns to the evolution engine as opportunity signals for workflow/skill candidates.
help.workingMemoryBridge: Inject reflection insights into the agent's working memory.
help.memoryCandidateBridge: Write high-confidence learned rules as memory candidates for long-term retention.
help.dreamAnnotateLineAges: Annotate content with age hints during Dream consolidation.
help.domainPacks: Enable domain pack discovery and prompt/tool injection.
help.pairing: Require sender pairing/approval for channel access.
help.configPath: The gateway configuration file currently in use.
help.outputLanguage: Choose the language for Agent-generated content (replies, meta-cognition, dreams, etc.). Leave empty to let the LLM decide.
help.auxiliaryEnabled: Route background tasks through a cheaper auxiliary model when available.
help.providerRetryMode: How model requests are retried when they fail.
help.webFetchUseJinaReader: Use Jina reader for better content extraction when fetching web pages.
help.sessionSearchEnabled: Enable local search across historical chat sessions.
help.sessionSearchBackend: Choose the local search implementation used for session history.
help.sessionSearchSemanticEnabled: Enable semantic search enhancement for better relevance.
help.sessionSearchRebuildOnStart: Rebuild the full session search index on every startup.
help.contentReadUseJinaReader: Prefer Jina reader for structured site readers when available.
help.execAllowUnsafeExec: Relax additional safety restrictions on the exec tool.
help.execShellSyntaxPolicy: Control which shell syntax features the exec tool allows.
help.myEnabled: Register the my tool so the agent can inspect its own runtime state.
help.myAllowSet: Let the my tool modify runtime state, not just read it.
help.restrictToWorkspace: Restrict file access and command execution to the workspace directory.
help.auditSecurityOnPolicyDenial: Record policy-denied tool calls as security audit events.
help.subagentMode: Control which capabilities sub-agents expose to themselves by default.
help.evolutionMode: Overall strategy for self-learning and optimization proposals.
help.evolutionAllowManualOverride: Allow manual overrides of automatic evolution decisions.
help.evolutionDryRun: Only analyze and evaluate without applying evolution artifacts.
help.evolutionOutcomeArchiveEnabled: Keep evolution results and conclusions for later review.
help.evolutionDependencyStaleCleanupEnabled: Auto-clean stale dependency snapshots from the evolution pipeline.
help.evolutionAutoVerifyWorkflows: Verify workflow proposals automatically when confidence is high enough.
help.evolutionSkillCandidatesEnabled: Generate skill candidates from repeating behavior patterns.
help.evolutionFeedbackCalibrationEnabled: Incorporate user feedback into evolution scoring.
help.evolutionSandboxEnabled: Evaluate evolution artifacts in a read-only sandbox.
help.evolutionTrialEnabled: Run verified evolution artifacts in an isolated trial.
help.evolutionTrialIsolatedWorkspace: Run trials in a separate workspace.
help.evolutionTrialReadOnlyToolsOnly: Further restrict trial permissions to read-only tools only.
help.pairingAllowSelfApprove: Allow self-approval of pairing requests within the same session.
help.deviceEnabled: Enable tool registration for real-world device interaction.
help.deviceLightingEnabled: Enable dedicated lighting device control capabilities.
help.deviceMode: Whether device tools simulate execution or send real commands.
help.deviceBackend: Backend implementation used by device tools.

tenants.title: Tenant Management
tenants.description: Configure who can access this OriginAgent instance.

intro.title: What is a tenant?
intro.body: A tenant is an identity in your household that can talk to the Agent. Each person maps to one tenant; the Agent remembers each tenant's preferences, conversation history, and permissions. The owner is also a tenant, but typically pre-binds their Telegram account and skips the pairing flow.
intro.ownerBody: Hardcode your Telegram account in the config; it auto-binds on startup. claimableByPairing must be OFF to prevent impersonation.
intro.familyBody: Create an unbound tenant with claimableByPairing ON. Family members run /pairing to get a code, you approve it (in WebUI or chat), then they /pairing claim to bind.

tenants.tenantIdHelp: Internal identifier — pick any name, e.g. dad, mom, owner. Cannot be changed after creation; used only for system-internal recognition.
tenants.displayNameHelp: How the Agent addresses this user in conversation.
tenants.bindingsHelp: Bind this tenant to a specific chat account. Owner typically fills in their Telegram here; leave empty for family so they can self-bind via pairing.
tenants.bdiEnabledHelp: Enable advanced cognition: long-term memory, goal management, proactive planning. Recommended ON for owner; optional for family (when OFF, the Agent won't remember their cross-session preferences).
tenants.claimableByPairingHelp: Allow family members to self-bind this identity via a pairing code. MUST be OFF for owner (prevents impersonation); turn ON for family tenants so they get a claim prompt when they message the bot.
tenants.permissionsHelp: What this tenant can ask the Agent to do. Recommend all ON for owner; restrict as needed for family.
tenants.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. It will cascade-delete: tenant {{id}}'s channel bindings, conversation history (session file), and workspace directory. If this is you (owner), your messages will fall back to the guest identity after deletion.
tenants.channelHelp: Which app the family member uses to talk to the Agent.
tenants.senderIdHelp: Telegram user ID (digits only). Message @userinfobot to get yours.
tenants.label: Label
tenants.labelHelp: A note for this binding, useful to tell multiple devices apart.
tenants.noBindings: No channel bindings yet. Owner adds their Telegram here; leave empty for family.
tenants.empty: No tenants yet. Pick "Add Myself" or "Add Family Member" above to get started.
